description:
● Developed innovative Augmented Reality (AR) replay tool and pixel difference IoU performance metric to remotely render and compare different SLAM algorithm traces.
● Collected and processed user trial data for audio-visual AI assisted task guidance on AR systems.
● Created rehab games with Unity to test RL VI-SLAM on platforms including Hololens 2 and Quest 3.
● Constructed dynamic LLM agent interfaced with OpenAI API to proactively assist in game performance.
● Co-authored research papers under review at IEEE EMBC, ImmerCom, and AAAI.

● Teach embedded systems, programming, digital signal processing (DSP), and machine learning concepts.
● Exhibited excellent communication instructing over 30 students in the Major Design course for DSP.

● Developed Android application for the shop floor using C# Xamarin Forms and .NET, enhancing operational efficiency for workers by up to 45 minutes per shift.
● Designed intuitive and responsive user interfaces using XAML, facilitating streamlined tasks like printing documents and labels, recording completed jobs, reporting part defects, and logging labor hours.
● Implemented RESTful Web API using ASP.NET to connect to SQL server database, enabling real-time data retrieval and updates, such as supervisor email alerts.

● Exhibited excellent communication instructing over 60 students in Engineering Electromagnetics course.
● Taught E&M concepts, use of tools such as Oscilloscopes and Waveform Generators, and lab protocol.
